tokens.gig.min: a Gig sitting at its minimum value
tokens.gig.max: a Gig sitting at its maximum value
tokens.gig.high8: a Gig with 8 or more value
tokens.gig.pair: a value-pair — two Gigs showing the same value
tokens.gig.distinct: Gigs showing different values from each other
tokens.gig.even: a Gig with an even value
tokens.gig.odd: a Gig with an odd value
tokens.gig.swap: swapping or setting Gigs between players
tokens.gig.d20: a d20 in the Gig area
tokens.gig.d6: a d6 in the Gig area
tokens.gig.d4: a d4 in the Gig area
tokens.gear.equip: getting Gear attached to a Unit
tokens.gear.equipped: a Unit that is carrying Gear
tokens.gear.sacrifice: defeating your own Gear on purpose
tokens.gear.tutor: finding Gear from the deck or trash
tokens.spend.trigger: a payoff for spending your own Unit or Legend
tokens.legend.go_solo: GO SOLO — playing a Legend as a Unit
tokens.trash.self: putting your own cards into the trash
tokens.trash.recur: playing or returning cards from the trash
tokens.unit.ready: readying a Unit for another attack
tokens.unit.adrenaline: attacking the turn a Unit is played
tokens.power.pump: giving a Unit more power for the turn
tokens.power.threshold: crossing a 10-power step for an extra stolen Gig
tokens.eddie.ready: readying Eddies — extra money this turn
tokens.cred.more: having MORE Street Cred than a Rival
tokens.cred.less: having LESS Street Cred than a Rival
tokens.cred.even: Street Cred being an even number
tokens.behind.gigs: a Rival being 2+ Gigs ahead of you
